text:
Question: What happens if I don't recharge before my plan expires?

Answer: Your outgoing services (calls, SMS, data) are suspended, though you can typically still receive incoming calls for a grace period (commonly 15-90 days depending on the plan) before the number is recycled per licence conditions. Recharge promptly to avoid deactivation.

title: What happens if I don't recharge before my plan expires?
